svg.text: PAPER CRAFT / AIRCRAFT COLLECTION / SHAPE STUDY
44 pieces each. Segmented shells; join in number order. Use the updated online guide.
Outer outline: cut | Grey dashes: facets | Blue dashes: tabs | Lilac: glue.
Print single-sided at 100% / Actual size. No Fit to page. Use 100-120 gsm paper.
